title: Small, budget-quality bathroom rug; not very cushiony & non-slip backing won’t last many washes
text:
Small, budget-quality bathroom rug; not very cushiony & non-slip backing won’t last many washes. This is a very small mat. Also, it is not as cushiony as I expected as I have other Chenille Bath Rugs that are much more plush. In addition, since this has a thin non-slip backing, this will not last many washes.

I consider this a budget-quality bathroom rug. Had I been able to sample this before I ordered it, I would never have selected it as it is not the quality I prefer.

Nevertheless, it is functional and does absorb some water when exiting the shower.

The current price of $14.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this quality.
